content.short: ASXN publishes research and analytics dashboards covering Hyperliquid markets.
content.description: Research and data sit together at ASXN, which publishes analysis alongside the dashboards that analysis is built on. Its data platform concentrates on Hyperliquid, tracking the metrics its research team uses rather than whatever was easiest to index. ASXN also operates a validator, offering delegated HYPE staking to holders who want to earn staking rewards through it.
